titulo: Bigfoot Left Footprints at My Back Door | Cryptid Horror #Shorts
titulo_pt: Bigfoot deixou pegadas na minha porta dos fundos
resumo_pt: Uma família no Oregon ouve passos no telhado. O marido vê o Bigfoot pela janela, pega a câmera e filma. Na última noite a esposa sai de casa e fica rindo com ele na floresta.
descricao:
Footprints two feet long. Right outside the back door.

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Based on American folklore. Images are AI-generated.

scenes.text: Every night at 3:17, something walked across our roof in Oregon.
scenes.pt: Toda noite às 3h17, alguma coisa andava no telhado da nossa casa no Oregon.
scenes.visual: wooden cabin in an Oregon forest at night, moonlight on the roof

scenes.text: Through the kitchen window: eight feet tall. Yellow eyes.
scenes.pt: Olhei pela janela da cozinha. Dois metros e meio. Olhos amarelos.
scenes.visual: tall hairy bigfoot standing outside a kitchen window at night, yellow eyes

scenes.text: My wife said it was raccoons.
scenes.pt: Minha esposa disse que eram guaxinins.
scenes.visual: woman in a gray sweater at a kitchen sink, dismissive face, lamp light

scenes.text: Next morning, the mud was full of footprints.
scenes.pt: Na manhã seguinte, a lama estava cheia de pegadas.
scenes.visual: giant bare footprints in mud near a wooden cabin at dawn

scenes.text: Two feet long, leading to our back door.
scenes.pt: Dois pés de comprimento. Indo direto pra porta dos fundos.
scenes.visual: huge footprints in mud leading to a back door of a wooden cabin

scenes.text: So I set a trail camera in the pines.
scenes.pt: Então montei uma câmera de trilha nos pinheiros.
scenes.visual: trail camera strapped to a pine tree in a dark forest, a man's hands adjusting it
tall hairy silhouette walking between pine trunks at night

scenes.text: It stopped right in front of the lens.
scenes.pt: Parou bem na frente da lente.
scenes.visual: bigfoot standing right in front of a trail camera lens, huge shoulders filling the frame

scenes.text: Its shoulders filled the whole frame.
scenes.pt: Os ombros enchiam o quadro inteiro.
scenes.visual: close up of a bigfoot's broad shoulders and dark hair in the forest, camera flash

scenes.text: Then it reached out and covered the lens.
scenes.pt: Aí estendeu a mão e cobriu a lente.
scenes.visual: huge hairy hand covering a trail camera lens in the dark

scenes.text: The camera was gone in the morning.
scenes.pt: De manhã, a câmera tinha sumido.
scenes.visual: empty trail spot in the pines at dawn, a broken camera on the ground

scenes.pt: E minha esposa também tinha sumido.
scenes.visual: empty cabin porch at dawn with the front door standing open

scenes.text: Her coat was on the porch. Her tracks went into the pines.
scenes.pt: O casaco dela estava na varanda. As pegadas dela entravam na mata.
scenes.visual: woman's gray sweater on a wooden porch, small footprints leading into pines

scenes.text: I found her last night, beside a fire in the woods.
scenes.pt: Encontrei ela ontem à noite, perto de uma fogueira na mata.
scenes.visual: a woman sitting with a bigfoot beside a campfire in the pine forest at night

scenes.text: She was laughing. She said he's family now.
scenes.pt: Ela estava rindo. Disse que ele agora é da família.
scenes.visual: woman laughing beside a bigfoot in firelight, both in the forest

personagens: the narrator is an Oregon man in his forties with a beard and a red plaid shirt; his wife has short brown hair and a gray sweater; the bigfoot is eight feet tall, dark brown hair, huge shoulders, yellow eyes
